system.description:
You manifest a construct of water release chakra in the shape of two claws that surround your hands, of your design and description.

For the duration, as an Action, you can choose to make a Spinning Claw attack or Slicing Water attack. If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or increase the ranks of Bleed inflicted with Spinning Claw +1 or the number of creatures you can target with Slicing Water by +1.

Spinning Claw. Make two melee ninjutsu attacks, comparing the result vs the AC of all targets of your choice within 5 feet of you. On a hit, you deal 2d6 cold damage and once per turn force affected creatures to make a Constitution Saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Bleed, on a failed save.

Slicing Water. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack as you slash the air releasing blades of thin water to slice into opposing creatures up to 15-feet away. On a hit, you deal 2d6 slashing damage as the affected creature becomes sheathed in vibrating water until the start of your next turn. If the target moves or is moved at least 5 feet before the start of your next turn, it explodes, dealing 1d6 cold damage to the affected creature and all creatures of your choice within 5 feet of the original target.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of both the attack and the explosion damage by 1d6.
